purpose: Post-hoc instrument-independence sensitivity audit; not a preregistered primary analysis
source: GWAS Catalog REST API v2 curated associations
lookup: All exact rsIDs present in frozen univariable, bidirectional and multivariable instrument sets. No outcome-based instrument selection. No LD proxies in this exact-variant screen.

primary_screen.education_cognition: educational|education attainment|years of schooling|intelligence|cognitive ability|cognitive performance

expanded_screen.glycemia: diabetes|glycated hemoglobin|glycated haemoglobin|fasting glucose|fasting insulin|insulin resistance

exclusions: Study vascular endpoints never trigger exclusions. Smoking and adiposity phenotypes retained. Primary screen flags potential upstream/shared pathways, expanded cardiometabolic screen may also remove vertical pathways. Association alone does not establish horizontal pleiotropy or independence violation.
models: Retain all original primary models; compare exact-rsID primary screen and expanded screen in six IVW models, six two-exposure MVMR models and two bidirectional models. Recompute FDR within each original six-outcome family and each sensitivity scheme; compute conditional F after removal.

proxy_amendment.reason: Source identity verification identified actual proxies retained under target rsID labels. Add all archived actual proxies to exact-variant lookup, without changing phenotype thresholds.
proxy_amendment.screening_rule: A target is flagged if it or any of its actually used proxies meets the frozen screen. Apply the same exclusion set across outcomes. No genome-wide LD expansion.
